create_rl_environment: create a Python RL environment subclass implementing reset, step, observation_spec, and action_spec methods
create_timestep_restart: create a TimeStep with StepType.FIRST using the restart helper function with an observation
create_timestep_transition: create a TimeStep with StepType.MID using the transition helper function with reward, observation, and discount
create_timestep_termination: create a TimeStep with StepType.LAST and zero discount using the termination helper function
create_timestep_truncation: create a TimeStep with StepType.LAST and configurable discount using the truncation helper function
